lines.zh: 我小跑着过红土，步子轻快。
lines.en: I trot across the red earth, light-footed.

lines.zh: 我的头冠在前面，很显眼。
lines.en: My crest rides up front, hard to miss.

lines.zh: 我沿着沟边走，和同伴一起。
lines.en: I go along the gully's edge with the others.
Three steps, one look around.

lines.zh: 我从矮灌木间挤过，尾巴扫平草。
lines.en: I push through low shrubs, tail flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪很尖，抓得住石面。
lines.en: My claws are sharp and hold on stone.

lines.zh: 我从石柱的影子里跑过去。
lines.en: I run through a pillar's shadow.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面的同伴，不落后。
lines.en: I keep up with the one in front.
I trot a stretch and stop to breathe.
I turn aside to skirt a deep gully.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩着保持平衡。
lines.en: My tail swings for balance.
Gravel slips under my feet.

lines.zh: 我最后停在一块突起的石头上。
lines.en: I stop at last on a raised stone.
A few more steps and then I stop.
I crouch with my tail on the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，看天上的影子。
lines.en: I lift my head to watch shadows in the sky.

lines.zh: 我的头冠被风吹得有点歪。
lines.en: Wind tilts my crest a little.
I'm grooming my winglike forelimbs.
One of the pack lies beside me.

lines.zh: 我伏在恶地石上，喉咙滚了滚。
lines.en: I lie on the badlands stone, throat working.
I'm sniffing for damp in the air.
I hold still, keeping very low.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，在光下反亮。
lines.en: My eyes are large and catch the light.
A stone shifted over there.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，越过石头看你。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to see you over the rocks.
I shake the dust off.

lines.zh: 我把脚爪在石头上磨了磨。
lines.en: I scrape my claws on the stone.
I look up, waiting for the pack to move.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，我不敢靠近。
lines.en: You're standing there. I won't come close.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，冠对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head, crest toward you.

lines.zh: 我往同伴那边挪了半步。
lines.en: I shift half a step toward the pack.
You stand a long way above me.
A sound squeezes out of my throat.
I want to run, but not to look afraid.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看不懂。
lines.en: I can't make out what's in your hand.
I cock my head and size you up.

lines.zh: 这地方还有我几个同伴。
lines.en: I've several of the pack here.
If you back off, I won't call.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，我缩了缩。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, so I flinch.
I look from your boot tips up to your knees.

lines.zh: 我跳开，爪子在石上刮出痕。
lines.en: I spring aside, claws raking the stone.
I run with a limp.
I shrink into a crack in the stones.

lines.zh: 血滴在红土上，看不出来。
lines.en: Blood on red earth. You can't tell.
The pack has closed in.
One of my feet found nothing.
I keep low and pant.
It hurts, but I'm still up.
My crest is knocked askew.
I can still run. Don't underestimate me.
I caught that smell.
The smell of meat. I don't quite trust it.
I creep a small half step forward.
The pack is watching. I must be careful.
Set it lower and I can reach.
I stretch my neck and try.
Enough here for a few of us.
I smelled it first, so I go first.
I get half way and stop.
Right. Coming.
You lunged and I sprang clear.
I'm small. Don't tread on me.
I duck into a pillar's shadow.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得翻了个身。
lines.en: That knocked me over.
I get up and shake myself.
The hackles on my neck are up.
I dart under your legs.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我旁边的石头。
lines.en: You crushed the stone beside me.
I run low to the ground.
No harm. I can still run.

lines.zh: 我们一群一起猎，一起歇。
lines.en: We hunt and rest as a pack.

lines.zh: 头冠大的更显眼，我就是。
lines.en: Bigger crests stand out. Mine does.

lines.zh: 先跟着队伍跑一段再说。
lines.en: Let's run with the pack a while first.

lines.zh: 我们个头小，靠的是成群。
lines.en: We're small. Numbers are our strength.
You couldn't keep up with us.
The pack is here. Don't be rash.
When the sun drops, we'll move.
My life's neither long nor short.
There's a stone out of the wind here.
Lie down first. Don't stand over me.
I carry it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 骨头太小，我一下就咬碎。
lines.en: The bone's small; one bite breaks it.

lines.zh: 我把东西拖到石头后面。
lines.en: I drag it behind a stone.

lines.zh: 同伴凑过来，我挡了一下。
lines.en: The pack crowded in; I blocked them.
So heavy I can't drag it.
I scratch the soil aside with a claw.
What fell by the gully, I can reach.
This doesn't look like meat.

lines.zh: 我把它埋起来，等会儿再来。
lines.en: I bury it and will come back.
Good. Enough for a mouthful.
The stone over there moved.
I lower my head and lean forward.

lines.zh: 同伴已经绕到另一边了。
lines.en: One of the pack has circled to the far side.
Several of us go at once.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的腿，那里好下口。
lines.en: I watch its legs. Easier to bite there.
At this distance one dash gets me there.
The rock moved; I move first.
It's bigger than me, but there's only one.
My claws are already spread.
I count how many paces remain.

lines.zh: 恶地的风，把你们的味道送过来了。
lines.en: Badland wind carries your scent to me.
I flatten and go in low.

lines.zh: 它没察觉我贴着草过来。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me coming through the grass.
Done. Found you.

lines.zh: 我头上的冠，薄得像刀片。
lines.en: The crest on my head is thin as a blade.
I move in stops and starts, closing late.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一边叫了一声。
lines.en: One of the pack calls from the far side.
It turned its head, so I advance.
We've got it in the middle.
I keep very low, almost flat.
It's looking for us and can't keep track.
I count how often it shifts its feet.
Two more steps and I reach it.
The pillar blocks its view.
I close in from behind.
I keep my breathing very light.
The pack moves first; I follow.
This very moment.

lines.zh: 我们几个都在这个位置。
lines.en: We're all in position.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁走，不发出声。
lines.en: I keep to the rock face without a sound.
It looks this way, so I stop.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它的腿弯上。
lines.en: I bite into the back of its knee.
I rake once and pull back.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我咬住了。
lines.en: Not heavy, but I've got hold.
The pack hits from the other side.
I'm thrown off and roll.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划开了它的袖子。
lines.en: My claws open its sleeve.
That should slow it.

lines.zh: 我跳到它背上，又滑下来。
lines.en: I leap onto its back and slide off.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的后腿，死不松口。
lines.en: I clamp onto its hind leg and will not let go.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就松口跑开。
lines.en: It turns, so I let go and run.
I put all my strength into that bite.
It's giving ground; we press.
I leap up and rake its hand.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在护腿上，牙硌得疼。
lines.en: I bite the leg guard and my teeth jar.
I'm kicked away, get up, and go again.
Now we're all biting.

lines.zh: 我从红土里钻出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I push out of the red earth and shake.
Two of the pack are a few steps away.

lines.zh: 我把头冠抬起，看这片恶地。
lines.en: I raise my crest and survey the badlands.
The wind is all dust.

lines.zh: 我落脚很轻，几乎没声音。
lines.en: I land lightly, almost silently.
Lots of stone here. Good cover.
I run one small circuit to test my legs.

lines.zh: 我的影子比同伴小一圈。
lines.en: My shadow's a size smaller than the others'.
I stop under a pillar.

lines.zh: 沟壑把这块地分成几片。
lines.en: The gullies split this ground into pieces.
I stretch my neck and listen.
Right. I'm with the pack.
I crawl out of the rubble, all dust.
The pack is there. I run over.
One circle around the stone pillar to look.

lines.zh: 我落脚的地方正好有阴。
lines.en: The spot I land in happens to be shaded.
Fire passes and my hide tightens.

lines.zh: 我从石柱上滑下来，摔在碎石里。
lines.en: I slip off the pillar into the gravel.

lines.zh: 我这么小，水一下就没了顶。
lines.en: Small as I am, the water closes over me at once.
The blast throws me a long way.
An arrow goes through my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的爪子抓不住地。
lines.en: That force won't let my claws grip.
No food, and my strength keeps draining.
Lightning strikes and my limbs lock straight.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有落脚处，我爪子在空抓。
lines.en: Nothing to land on in the void; my claws grasp at air.
